resolutions.answer: The domain partitions into eight truth-relevant classes recorded in input-class-analysis.md: C0 the n=0 identity; C1 intra-month advances crossing no boundary; C2 single month-boundary rollovers, one subclass per month exercising each month-length constant, refined with next-to-last-day boundary-approach starts; C3 the February leap distinction (2024 leap vs 2023/2025 non-leap); C4 the Dec 31 -> Jan 1 year rollover for each domain year; C5 multi-month spans up to n=60 (at most two boundaries reachable); C6 the century leap sub-conditions, vacuous in this domain; C7 the parse/format round-trip. Together these exercise every month-length constant, the leap branch both ways, every month-boundary rollover reachable with n <= 60, and the year-boundary rollover within 2023-2025.

VIOLATED. The shipped DAYS table gives August (index 7) 30 days instead of the true 31. Witness inside the domain: ["2023-08-30", 1]. All other classes check out against the true calendar; the defect class also contains e.g. ['2024-08-30', 1] and ['2023-08-01', 30].
